description: The added documentation overstates coverage as “all tensors” and omits the leading -- from the long option.
trigger: Following the new image-dump option description.
expected_behavior: Documentation names --image_dump and describes images of selected linear weights and their regularized forms.
actual_behavior: The text says “-img / image_dump” and “all tensors,” whereas the parser registers --image_dump and main only dumps its selected Linear quantization targets.

verification.description: Compared the added documentation with the parser registration and the linear-target selection surrounding the image writes.
